title: Split Life Crisis Vacation Rental
meta_description: Split Life Crisis is a 5.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionSplit Life CrisisWaterColor Beach Community – Spartina Circle, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459New to Rental MarketHome Highlights4 bedrooms plus bonus bunk room (see “Room Details” tab above)3 full baths, 1 half bathSleeps 14 guests (Home comes with 10 WaterColor Amenity Wristbands; required for ages 5+)Two luxurious King master suites (one per floor; one features a separate soaker tub and custom showers)Gourmet, fully stocked kitchenDining area with large 8-person tableSpacious screened-in front and back porchesGas grillComfortable living areaFirst-floor laundry with full-sized washer and dryer3-vehicle drivewayFour 26" adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb rentals available upon request)The Perfect GetawayMake every moment count at Split Life Crisis! This 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath retreat offers stylish open living spaces, relaxing porches, and two king suites perfect for family and friends. Whether you’re sipping morning coffee or enjoying sunset cocktails, this home is designed for comfort and fun.Unbeatable LocationSteps from Camp WaterColor, your backyard destination for poolside fun, water slides, lazy rivers, and on-site dining. Guests also enjoy access to all WaterColor community pools, the Beach Club, tennis courts, pickleball, and scenic biking/walking trails.Getting around is easy with the complimentary WaterColor tram, which stops just outside your door and provides quick access to the Beach Club, Town Center, Tennis facility, and every community pool.Community AmenitiesCelebrated for eco-friendly design and scenic beauty, WaterColor offers:Multiple community poolsCamp WaterColorPrivate beach access & Beach ClubTown Center shopping & diningWestern Lake accessTennis & Pickleball centerParks, playgrounds, and nature trailsWellness amenities (additional fees may apply)Note: Golf cart rentals are available via The Electric Cart Company. Only one cart per home; limited availability; first-come, first-served.ParkingDriveway accommodates 3 vehiclesRented golf carts must park in designated on-property spacesBooking & PoliciesNo smokingPets not allowed (except certified service animals)50% of total cost due at booking; balance due 60 days prior (or in full if booking within 60 days)Optional travel insurance available (purchase before final payment)Ring camera doorbell installedCheck-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTGuests must be 25+ years old to bookImportant: WaterColor wristbands are required for all guests 5+ and limited to 10 per home. Provide accurate guest numbers at least two weeks before arrival.
